key_points: Capital One raised MGM Resorts price target to $57 from $53, signaling analyst optimism.
MGM Resorts stays independent after Diller’s $18 billion bid was dropped, removing a potential takeover premium.
Stock declined after the deal collapse, as noted by Yahoo Finance and relative underperformance vs. peers.
Form 4 filings and RSU/PSU vesting updates are routine insider transactions with no material signal.
BetMGM will discuss its Q3 results on Oct 13, providing a near‑term catalyst for the stock.
